text: The town gathers
The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, and Terra. Nobody knows who the killer is.

Terra is eliminated by vote on Day 2, and Terra was the killer. Gemma and Luna are the last two players at the table.
The town wins. The roles were: Sonnet the citizen, Haiku the officer, Gemma the citizen, Sol the doctor, Luna the citizen, and Terra the killer.

Six players sat down, and Haiku, the officer, was killed on night one after questioning Sonnet. Sonnet spent day one calling out Terra's deflections, but the table voted Sonnet out, and Sol the doctor died on night two. The turning point came on day two, when Luna and Gemma pressed Terra's habit of turning every question back on someone else, and Terra admitted to being the killer and was voted out. The town won, with Gemma and Luna the last two standing.
